wireContract: Additive over 0.73.0: GET /communities/:communityId/join-eligibility now returns a discriminated union. Composed communities (a current curated-nationality policy) emit join_eligibility_version=provider_choice_v2 with requirements.human_identity, an optional requirements.nationality carrying requirement_hash, the currently bound provider_id, accepted_provider_ids [self.pass, zkpassport], ceremony_intent_id and generation, and a requirement-typed next_action whose start action names the requirement, the bound provider, and the server-issued ceremony intent id. Palm-only and membership states keep the v1 projection unchanged. A 0.73.0 consumer fails strict decoding when a provider_choice_v2 payload arrives, so the Solid consumer must move to 0.74.0 before composed join eligibility is advertised.

verification.status: Cut from the nationality lane with the composed join eligibility contract and provider-choice projection; the focused PostgreSQL suite proves issuance, either-provider starts, generation-fenced switching, completion, and the separate evidence-rechecked join. No consumer-side update is included in this lane, and the Solid upgrade remains a separate coordinated step.
